prompt: What preparation I need to do to hike grand canyon rim-to-rim
response: For a rim-to-rim hike in the Grand Canyon, moderate preparation is sufficient. You can acclimate by doing some light walks beforehand. Carrying a day's supply of water and some snacks will be enough, as you can refill at the canyon. Sturdy shoes are recommended but not essential. The trip can be completed in a day if you start early.
